quote: I have been on several military history tours, most recently Frank de Planta’s Valor Tour of the battlegrounds of southern Italy. By far and away, I found Frank to be the best military tour guide I’ve encountered. He takes one to the actual battlefields, and colorfully points out the tactical dilemmas and experiences of the men who fought there. But crucially, he also explains the larger picture – the strategies of the generals and politicians, their thinking, their motives, their mistakes – all necessary for one to understand fully the history of what one is seeing.
name: Dr Jack Stauder
from: Professor of Cultural Anthropology, University of Massachusetts Dartmouth, USA
